what: The published Amplify portal, built from the design files in app/ by tools/build_site.py

transforms.name: lang
transforms.why: screen readers need the page language

transforms.name: head
transforms.why: a published page needs a title, a description and an icon

transforms.name: no-image-slot-runtime
transforms.why: the drop-zone runtime is design-time only, and asks for a state file that does not exist

transforms.name: default-view
transforms.why: the side-by-side review view is for design review; a published portal opens on the portal

transforms.name: default-view-fallback
transforms.why: the same default where props are absent

transforms.name: slot-splash-logo
transforms.why: no partner logo is licensed; the Amplify mark beside it already identifies the page

transforms.name: slot-hero
transforms.why: a drop-zone cannot ship; the annual sitting is drawn instead

transforms.name: slot-participation
transforms.why: a drop-zone cannot ship; the brand's primitives replace the photo

transforms.name: slot-equality
transforms.why: a drop-zone cannot ship; the brand's primitives replace the photo

transforms.name: slot-education
transforms.why: a drop-zone cannot ship; the brand's primitives replace the photo

transforms.name: slot-empowerment
transforms.why: a drop-zone cannot ship; the brand's primitives replace the photo

transforms.name: masthead-unofficial
transforms.why: the masthead names UKYP; it must also say this is not UKYP's own service

transforms.name: splash-unofficial
transforms.why: the splash is the first screen; the disclaimer belongs on it too

transforms.name: pledge-samples
transforms.why: the five seed pledges read as real people; they are invented and must say so

transforms.name: pledge-local
transforms.why: say where a pledge goes: nowhere, it stays on this device

transforms.name: copilot-ready
transforms.why: the copilot only knew the design host's window.claude.complete; on the published page the model is reached through the artifact's sample capability

transforms.name: copilot-call
transforms.why: route both copilot calls through one helper that picks whichever model connection the host offers

transforms.name: copilot-helpers
transforms.why: the helper itself: design host first, then the published artifact's sample capability, else none (the existing fallback text then shows)

transforms.name: footer
transforms.why: the usual footer: disclaimers, disclosures, transparency, contact and colophon

transforms.name: map-back-link
transforms.why: the portal is index.html in the built site

transforms.name: map-leaflet-css
transforms.why: a published artifact blocks stylesheets from unpkg; ship the same bytes (SRI-verified at build)

transforms.name: map-leaflet-js
transforms.why: serve Leaflet from the site too, so the map has no third-party script dependency

transforms.name: map-icon
transforms.why: favicon

transforms.name: map-outline
transforms.why: street tiles are remote images, which a published artifact blocks; draw a local land outline under the markers so the map always shows where an area is

transforms.name: map-outline-theme
transforms.why: the outline follows the theme toggle, as the tiles do

transforms.name: map-no-street-tiles
transforms.why: the design's CARTO tiles now answer every request with an 'API key required' image (a 200, so the page's own tileerror fallback never fires), and a published artifact blocks remote images anyway: the local outline is the basemap

transforms.name: map-attribution
transforms.why: credit what the map now draws

transforms.name: map-outline-attribution
transforms.why: the map's own attribution control names the outline source
